highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 upgrades to Skia m151 with faster color, shaping, and text-processing paths.
highlights_body: It also fixes an image-decoding resource leak and adds .NET 11-ready WebAssembly native assets.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer moves to Skia m151 and includes upstream maintenance fixes.

bullets.lead: Encoded image subset decoding no longer leaks native resources
bullets.detail: SKImage.FromEncodedData with an SKData subset correctly releases its native resource on all paths.

bullets.lead: Color and text operations allocate less
bullets.detail: Common SKColor conversions and parsing, tag parsing, HarfBuzz UTF-8 input, and glyph shaping avoid avoidable interop and managed allocations.
Includes Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries and exception handling support for .NET 11 WebAssembly workloads.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Cleaned up the WebAssembly Skia build by removing a redundant define

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m151 line with the Skia engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added managed color and text-path performance improvements and the image resource leak fix.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 added the final WebAssembly runtime assets and upstream m151 fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp improves UTF-8 input, tag parsing, and glyph-result access to reduce allocations during shaping.
